existing_features.title: Create a unified game application home experience that lets users choose between four game modes: Ludo, Chess, Carrom, and Cricket, and provides consistent navigation to enter/exit a game back to the home screen.

Implement an MVP Ludo game mode playable locally on a single device with 2–4 players, including basic rules: dice roll, piece movement along a track, capturing opponent pieces, and win condition when a player gets all pieces home.

Implement an MVP Chess game mode playable locally on a single device for two players, enforcing standard chess movement rules, turn-taking, captures, check indication, and game end on checkmate or resignation.

Implement an MVP Carrom game mode as a local single-device game with a top-down board, striker aiming, adjustable power, turn-taking, basic collision/pocketing, and simple scoring (pocketed pieces add points; fouls remove points or end turn).

Implement an MVP Cricket game mode as a simple local single-device mini-game with innings, runs, wickets, and a clear win condition. The gameplay should be deterministic and skill/choice-driven (e.g., timing-based batting or choice-based shot vs bowl) without requiring real-time multiplayer.

Add a simple backend data model and API to persist per-user game statistics (e.g., games played, wins, losses, best score where applicable) for each of the four game modes, and display these stats in the UI.

Establish a coherent visual theme for the entire app (colors, typography, layout, and components) appropriate for a casual multi-game arcade, and apply it consistently across the home screen and all four game modes.

Add and render generated static visual assets (icons/illustrations) for the four game modes in the home screen and (where appropriate) as headers within each game mode screen. Store these assets under frontend/public/assets/generated.

Update the HomeScreen welcome heading element at XPath `/html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/h2[1]` (currently showing “Welcome to Game Arcade”) so that this element becomes a banner slider/carousel that cycles through 3 static banner images for Ludo, Chess, and Carrom.
Add the 3 new banner images as static assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` and wire the HomeScreen banner slider to use these exact filenames.

Add a simple, always-visible “Quick Play” home menu on the HomeScreen that lets players jump directly into each of the four game modes (Ludo, Chess, Carrom, Cricket) with one click/tap, using the existing onSelectGame(game) navigation flow.

Update the Home screen UI layout and styling to closely match the look/structure shown in the uploaded reference image (Screenshot_20260131_000048.jpg): a clean top header, a prominent hero section with a centered device/phone mock image, and large, bold headline + subheadline text; keep the existing ability to navigate into Ludo/Chess/Carrom/Cricket via the existing onSelectGame(game) flow.

Apply the visual style shown in the uploaded reference image (Screenshot_20260129_125437.jpg) to the Ludo game experience: use a modern glassmorphism look (blurred/soft gradient background, translucent rounded card panels, strong primary CTA button) for the Ludo pre-game setup screen and in-game HUD panels, without changing Ludo gameplay rules.

Remove the 'Create Game' option from the app UI wherever it appears (buttons, menus, headings, or navigation actions), ensuring users can still start local games via existing 'Start Game/New Game/Quick Play' flows.

Add new static visual assets to support the updated Home hero and Ludo glassmorphism styling, store them under frontend/public/assets/generated, and wire the updated screens to use them directly from that folder.
Replace the current non-realistic visuals with more realistic images for Ludo, Chess, and Carrom, keeping the existing asset filenames/paths so the UI updates without changing navigation or gameplay.

Replace the current HomeScreen hero content (the “LUDO GAME SOURCE CODE” text block, the supporting paragraph content, and the phone image) with a full-width, top-of-home banner slider/carousel containing exactly 3 realistic slides: Ludo, Chess, and Carrom.
Add 3 new realistic banner images as static assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` and wire the HomeScreen banner slider to use those exact filenames.
Remove the Cricket game mode from the app UI and navigation so users cannot start or access Cricket from the HomeScreen, Quick Play, or in-app routing/state navigation.
Update the authenticated stats UI to no longer show Cricket statistics in the StatsSummary tiles, while keeping the rest of the stats UI functional for Ludo, Chess, and Carrom.
Make the Carrom game visuals look more realistic (board appearance, pockets, and coin rendering) without changing Carrom gameplay rules or physics behavior.

Update the Home banner carousel to use improved, more modern slide designs while keeping exactly 3 slides (Ludo, Chess, Carrom) and keeping the existing banner image filenames/paths used by the carousel component.
Replace the HomeScreen game icon images for Ludo, Chess, and Carrom with more realistic, modern-looking icons while keeping the existing icon image filenames/paths used by HomeScreen.

Update the Quick Play section visuals to better match the uploaded reference image (IMG_20260217_142015.jpg) by using the new realistic game icons (image-based) instead of the current Lucide vector icons, while preserving the existing Quick Play titles/subtitle text and the onSelectGame(game) behavior.
